messages.author: 06e4859bec3a15b7
messages.subject: Metagene analysis of methylation w/ genomation
parts:
Hey all,

Is there an easy way to get a metagene plot from coverage filtered methylrawlist? I tried to convert it to a GRanges format but then I get this error. 

gene.obj <- readTranscriptFeatures("mm10.ucsc.genes.bed", 
                                            remove.unusual=TRUE,
                                            up.flank=1000,down.flank=1000,
                                            unique.prom=TRUE)
sm = ScoreMatrix(target = as(filtered.myobj[[1]],"GRanges"), windows = gene.obj)
Read 7477746 rows and 7 (of 7) columns from 0.222 GB file in 00:00:06
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘ScoreMatrix’ for signature ‘"GRanges", "GRangesList"’


Any idea how to solve this/ or what's wrong? Thanks!

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Metagene analysis of methylation w/ genomation
parts:
The GRanges objects should have a column containing methylation percentage or proportion. You can create such a column as follows:

gr=as(filtered.myobj[[1]],"GRanges")
mcols(gr)=gr$numCs/gr$coverage

Then you should use ScoreMatrix(), in this case I'm using promoters not whole gene.

sm = ScoreMatrix(target = gr, windows = gene.obj$promoters, bin.num=50, strand.aware=TRUE, weight.col="X", is.noCovNA = TRUE)

see also here for a similar problem:
http://zvfak.blogspot.de/2015/03/using-genomation-to-analyze-methylation.html

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: Metagene analysis of methylation w/ genomation
parts:
weight.col denotes the column name in GRanges object that has the methylation percentage/proportion info. Make sure you provide a valid column name and don't remove it if you want to get heatmap for methylation values.

Best,
Altuna
